column1: # Urdu starter confusion groups. These are candidate alternatives, never automatic replacements.
# Grammatical paradigms (gender/number agreement and function words).
# These differ by two characters, so the one-edit candidate builder could never offer them.
# Built from paradigms, not from benchmark sentences. Lexical pairs in eval/handwritten_a.tsv
# (e.g. آب/اب, شہد/شہر, ملک/مالک) are deliberately NOT listed, so they still measure unseen pairs.
